# Story 01 — Enhance tokens and theme foundation (Story: 10)

## Prerequisites

- **None.** The Identity & Access frontend (Story 5) already consumes the current `ThemeProvider` and CSS custom properties; this story upgrades the token layer and design-system underpinnings that those pages read from. Coordinate with owners of every `*.module.css` under `frontend/src/shared/components/` and `frontend/src/features/**` because token rename fallbacks must be kept until the token-consumer sweep in `## Migration / Rollback` is complete.

---

## Story Goal

Replace the current ad-hoc, single-layer theme in `frontend/src/shared/theme/` with a **two-layer token architecture** (raw scale → semantic aliases) that satisfies AC1–AC13 from the intake:

1. Every colour, spacing, radius, shadow, motion, and type value is exposed as a **CSS custom property** derived from a **semantic alias**, which in turn resolves to a **raw scale** primitive; components reference only the semantic layer.
2. The **light** palette in the intake (contrast-verified) is the authoritative source; a **dark** theme is *not* implemented but the alias structure must allow it to be added as a second alias set with **no component changes**.
3. Arabic and Latin type scales share a `--text-*` font-size token but expose **locale-scoped `--line-height-*` tokens** (Latin vs Arabic line-heights) plus a per-locale font-family stack.
4. A **lint rule** (or CI check) fails when a raw hex, pixel font-size or pixel spacing appears outside the token definition file(s).
5. A **living token documentation page** is added under `frontend/src/features/` (route: `/design-system/tokens`) that renders every token with its value, intended use, and measured contrast.
6. **RTL correctness** — the token layer/global CSS uses only logical properties, and the docs page includes a smoke test that toggles `dir="rtl"` on `<html>`.

**Not in scope** (mirrors the intake's "Out of scope"): dark-theme values, chart palette, icon-set drawing, marketing/email templates.

## Product rules (from story)

- **Current behaviour:** `frontend/src/shared/theme/tokens.ts` exports a **single-layer** `lightTheme` / `darkTheme` object with component-flavoured keys (`primary`, `primaryHover`, `surfaceMuted`, `textMuted`, `border`, `focus`). Components consume `--color-primary`, `--color-focus`, `--color-border`, etc. There is no raw scale; there is no lint rule against raw hex/px.
- **New behaviour:**
  - Two layers: **raw scale** (`--blue-600`, `--neutral-700`, `--neutral-500`, `--neutral-300`, …) and **semantic aliases** (`--color-action`, `--color-action-hover`, `--color-action-subtle`, `--color-text-strong`, `--color-text-default`, `--color-text-muted`, `--color-text-disabled`, `--color-border-input`, `--color-border-subtle`, `--color-surface`, `--color-surface-sunken`, `--color-success`, `--color-success-bg`, `--color-warning`, `--color-warning-bg`, `--color-danger`, `--color-danger-bg`, `--color-danger-solid`).
  - **Legacy aliases** (`--color-primary`, `--color-primary-hover`, `--color-secondary`, `--color-danger-hover`, `--color-focus`, `--color-bg`, `--color-surface-muted`, `--color-border`, `--color-text`, `--color-text-muted`) remain emitted, but each one now `= var(--color-<new-alias>)` so existing components keep rendering during the sweep in `## Migration / Rollback`.
  - `--focus-ring` becomes a full shorthand (`2px solid var(--color-action)` with 2px offset applied via `outline-offset`); components use it via `outline: var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: var(--focus-ring-offset);`.
  - New spacing tokens are `--space-1` … `--space-12` (4/8/12/16/20/24/32/40/48/64 px, 4-px grid). The **old aliases** (`--space-xs`, `--space-sm`, `--space-md`, `--space-lg`, `--space-xl`, `--space-xxl`, `--space-xxs`) resolve to `var(--space-N)` counterparts.
  - New radius tokens: `--radius-sm 6px` (was `4px`), `--radius-md 8px` (was `6px`), `--radius-lg 12px`, `--radius-full 9999px` (replaces `--radius-pill`; the old name remains as `var(--radius-full)`).
  - Shadows: add `--shadow-xs`; keep `--shadow-sm/md/lg` with the intake's rgba values.
  - Motion: add `--duration-fast 150ms`, `--duration-base 200ms`, `--ease-out cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)`.
  - Type scale: rename `--font-size-md` → `--text-sm` etc. (`--text-xs 12`, `--text-sm 14`, `--text-base 16`, `--text-lg 18`, `--text-xl 20`, `--text-2xl 24`, `--text-3xl 30`). Keep the old `--font-size-*` names as legacy aliases. Add **paired** `--line-height-*-latin` / `--line-height-*-arabic` tokens; a CSS selector `html[data-locale='ar']` maps `--line-height-<step>` → `--line-height-<step>-arabic`, otherwise `--latin`.
  - Font families: `--font-family-latin` = `Inter, system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif`; `--font-family-arabic` = `"IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Noto Sans Arabic", Tahoma, sans-serif`. `--font-family-base` (legacy) resolves to `var(--font-family-latin)` under `[data-locale='en']` and `var(--font-family-arabic)` under `[data-locale='ar']`.
  - **Dark theme placeholder**: `darkTheme` exports the *same* alias values as `lightTheme` with an `// TODO: dark-theme values (out of scope for Story 10)` comment. `setThemeName('dark')` still switches the object but produces the same visual output; this preserves AC12 without shipping unverified dark values.

Replace `ColorTokens` (line 1) with a new alias-shaped interface (`SemanticColorAliases`) covering the intake's palette. Keep `ColorTokens` as a **type alias** for backward compatibility:

```ts
export interface SemanticColorAliases {
  action: string;         // rawScale.blue600
  actionHover: string;    // rawScale.blue700
  actionSubtle: string;   // rawScale.blue50
  textStrong: string;     // rawScale.neutral900
  textDefault: string;    // rawScale.neutral700
  textMuted: string;      // rawScale.neutral500
  textDisabled: string;   // rawScale.neutral500 (on surface neutral100)

  borderSubtle: string;   // rawScale.neutral200

  warningBg: string;      // rawScale.amber50
  danger: string;         // rawScale.red700
  dangerBg: string;       // rawScale.red50
  dangerSolid: string;    // rawScale.red600
}

export type ColorTokens = SemanticColorAliases; // legacy re-export
```

### 3 — CSS variable emitter

**File: `frontend/src/shared/theme/cssVariables.ts`**

Rewrite `themeToCssVariables` (line 3) to emit **three** blocks:

1. **Raw scale** (`--blue-600`, `--neutral-700`, …). Include *every* member of `rawScale`, converted from camelCase to `--kebab-case`.
2. **Semantic aliases** whose values are `var(--<raw>)` strings (not literal hex) — e.g. `'--color-action': 'var(--blue-600)'`. Emit all `SemanticColorAliases` entries plus `--color-surface-disabled`.
3. **Legacy aliases** whose values are `var(--color-<new-alias>)` — e.g. `'--color-primary': 'var(--color-action)'`, `'--color-primary-hover': 'var(--color-action-hover)'`, `'--color-focus': 'var(--color-action)'`, `'--color-bg': 'var(--color-surface)'`, `'--color-surface-muted': 'var(--color-surface-sunken)'`, `'--color-border': 'var(--color-border-subtle)'`, `'--color-text': 'var(--color-text-default)'`, `'--color-danger-contrast': 'var(--color-surface)'`, `'--color-primary-contrast': 'var(--color-surface)'`, `'--color-danger-hover': 'var(--color-danger)'`.

Emit spacing: `--space-1` … `--space-12` **from the raw scale** and `--space-xxs`/`--space-xs`/`--space-sm`/`--space-md`/`--space-lg`/`--space-xl`/`--space-xxl` **as `var(--space-N)` references**.

Emit radii: `--radius-sm`, `--radius-md`, `--radius-lg`, `--radius-full`, `--radius-pill: var(--radius-full)`.

Emit shadows: `--shadow-xs/sm/md/lg`.

Emit type sizes and locale-scoped line heights: `--text-xs` … `--text-3xl`; `--line-height-xs-latin` … `--line-height-3xl-latin`; `--line-height-xs-arabic` … `--line-height-3xl-arabic`. Emit **the resolved `--line-height-*`** based on a `locale?: 'en' | 'ar'` parameter that defaults to `'en'` (see step 6 for the CSS selector that switches at runtime).

Emit legacy `--font-size-xs/sm/md/lg/xl` as `var(--text-*)` (map `md → text-sm` because current baseline size is 14 px per `tokens.ts:102`).

Emit motion: `--duration-fast`, `--duration-base`, `--ease-out`, `--focus-ring`, `--focus-ring-offset`.

Emit font families: `--font-family-latin`, `--font-family-arabic`. Do **not** emit a hard-coded `--font-family-base` — the switch is done by CSS selector.

Update `applyThemeToRoot(theme)` (line 65) to accept an optional 2nd argument `locale: 'en' | 'ar'` (default `'en'`) and forward it.

### 8 — Consumer sweep (repoint to semantic aliases)

For every `*.module.css` under `frontend/src/shared/components/` and `frontend/src/features/`, replace direct references as follows (drop-in — legacy aliases keep working, this pass makes semantics correct):

- `var(--color-primary)` → `var(--color-action)`
- `var(--color-primary-hover)` → `var(--color-action-hover)`
- `var(--color-primary-contrast)` → `var(--color-surface)`

- `var(--color-surface-muted)` → `var(--color-surface-sunken)`

- `var(--color-danger-contrast)` → `var(--color-surface)`
- `var(--font-size-md)` → `var(--text-sm)` (14 px baseline), `--font-size-lg` → `var(--text-base)`, etc.
- `var(--radius-pill)` → `var(--radius-full)`
- `opacity: 0.6` on `button:disabled` (`Button.module.css` line 18) → replace with `background: var(--color-surface-disabled); color: var(--color-text-disabled); border-color: var(--color-border-subtle); cursor: not-allowed;` (AC4 — disabled must remain at 4.5:1).

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **Component still using a legacy alias after the sweep** — Trigger: any `*.module.css` referencing `var(--color-primary)` etc. Expected behaviour: still renders correctly because `cssVariables.ts` emits the legacy → new alias mapping. Enforcement: the legacy aliases stay in `themeToCssVariables` until **all** consumers are migrated in Story NN+1; see `## Migration / Rollback`.
- **Locale toggled before ThemeProvider mounts** — Trigger: `main.tsx:25` runs `applyDocumentDirection(resolveInitialLocale())` **before** React renders, so `data-locale` is on `<html>` before the first paint (AC7 — no layout shift). Legacy fallbacks in `global.css` cover the pre-mount window. Enforcement: `frontend/src/main.tsx` (line 25) plus the new `data-locale` write in `documentDirection.ts:15`.
- **Font file fails to load** — Trigger: network error on the `.woff2`. Expected behaviour: `@font-face` uses `font-display: swap`; the `system-ui, Segoe UI, sans-serif` / `Tahoma, sans-serif` fallback renders immediately with no visible CLS. Enforcement: `global.css` `@font-face` block (step 6).
- **`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`** — Trigger: OS setting. Expected: all transitions/animations collapse to 0.01 ms; state changes still perceivable via colour and shape (AC11). Enforcement: `global.css` media block (step 6).
- **Disabled control** — Trigger: `<button disabled>`. Expected: text stays at 4.51:1 (`--color-text-disabled` on `--color-surface-disabled`); no `opacity` dimming (AC4). Enforcement: sweep in step 8 removes the `opacity: 0.6` at `Button.module.css:18`.
- **Focus indicator obscured by sticky header** — Trigger: focused row scrolls under a sticky element. Expected: components rendered inside a scroll container must not clip focus outlines. Documented in the docs page and enforced by not setting `overflow: hidden` on containers that hold focusable descendants (call out in step 10 doc copy).
- **RTL asymmetric corners** — Trigger: any component using `border-top-left-radius` etc. Expected: stylelint `use-logical` flags it; replace with `border-start-start-radius`. Zero existing violations today (grep confirmed) — the rule keeps future work honest.
- **Arabic diacritics clipping** — Trigger: `--text-sm` step under Arabic. Expected: `--line-height-sm-arabic = 24px` (vs Latin 20 px); the docs page renders a diacritic-heavy sample (e.g. "مُسْتَخْدِمٌ") at every step for visual verification (AC6).
- **Adding a dark theme later** — Trigger: someone supplies a new `SemanticColorAliases` object. Expected: `themeToCssVariables` re-runs with the new alias set; **no component change required** (AC12). Enforced by the alias→raw layering.
- **Raw hex smuggled through JS `style={{ color: '#abc' }}`** — Trigger: inline style with a raw hex. Expected: the ESLint rule in step 9 flags it. Enforcement: `frontend/eslint.config.js` `no-restricted-syntax` rule.

## Migration / Rollback

- **Migration order (single PR, but staged commits):**
  1. Land the token model (`tokens.ts`, `cssVariables.ts`, `ThemeProvider.tsx`, `index.ts`) + legacy aliases. All existing tests keep passing.
  2. Land `global.css` font/motion/data-locale updates + `documentDirection.ts` change.
  3. Sweep consumers (step 8).
  4. Add stylelint + ESLint restriction (step 9). Introduce **after** the sweep so CI doesn't fail on pre-existing files.
  5. Add the docs page (step 10) and i18n strings.
- **Rollback:** Each step reverts independently. If the docs page or lint rules cause CI failure, revert steps 9–10 while keeping steps 1–8 (the token layer alone is a safe no-op because legacy aliases still resolve).
- **Half-applied risk:** If step 1 lands and step 6 does not, `data-locale` is not written to `<html>` and Arabic line-heights fall back to Latin values (still legible, no crash). If step 8 lands but step 1 does not, the newly-referenced `--color-action` variable is undefined and browsers fall back to unstyled — always land step 1 first.

## Verification Steps

1. **Frontend runs:** From `frontend/`, `pnpm install && pnpm dev`. Load `http://localhost:5173/design-system/tokens` (dev-only route). Confirm every alias renders with a swatch and a resolved value.
2. **Frontend builds:** From `frontend/`, `pnpm build`. Must succeed with zero TypeScript errors.
3. **Style lint:** From `frontend/`, `pnpm lint:styles`. Must exit 0. Deliberately introduce `color: #ff0000;` into `Button.module.css` in a scratch commit and re-run — the run must **fail** (then revert).
4. **ESLint:** From `frontend/`, `pnpm lint`. Must exit 0.
5. **Unit + integration tests:** From `frontend/`, `pnpm test`. Every new test in `## Test Plan` passes; every prior test remains green.
6. **Locale swap:** In-app, use the existing locale switcher (see `frontend/src/shared/i18n/LocaleProvider.tsx`) to toggle to Arabic. Confirm `<html data-locale="ar" dir="rtl" lang="ar">`, that `.font-family` on `body` resolves to the Arabic stack, and that the docs page's line-height sample rows visibly grow.
7. **Reduced motion:** In DevTools → Rendering → "Emulate CSS media feature prefers-reduced-motion: reduce", hover a button and confirm no transition plays.
8. **Regression:** From `frontend/`, run the identity-access suites specifically — `pnpm test src/features/identity`. All existing component tests remain green (legacy aliases prove the compat layer works).
9. **Backend:** No backend changes required — do not build the backend.
